finding: P0 — 'sending a prompt throws the user back to Home'

root_cause.not: a route change (no hashchange router, no location mutation, no reset-on-error — confirmed again on the live path)
root_cause.is: app/src/shell/presence/presence.ts overloaded the `.talking` CSS class for two meanings: (a) a turn is in flight, and (b) a conversation exists to show. `runTurn`'s completion path ran `app.classList.remove('talking')` 600ms after EVERY turn, and presence.css ties the surface to that class: `.talking .thread{display:block}` / `.talking .hero{display:none}`. So the moment a reply arrived the thread was hidden and the greeting hero (the landing/Home screen) came back, even though the conversation was still loaded.

fix.new_module: app/src/shell/presence/conversation.ts — conversationVisible({turns,busy}) = busy || turns > 0 (the one tested decision)
fix.presence: refreshChatSurface() RECOMPUTES the class from conversationVisible; the completion path recomputes instead of removing. Failed turns stay in the session and name the subsystem (NETWORK / MODEL PROVIDER / KAI), preserve the input, and offer Retry without recording a duplicate user turn.

live_reproduction.harness: Chrome --headless=new over CDP (port 9223) against the real app: vite dev 127.0.0.1:1420/shell.html + the running KAI Core on 127.0.0.1:8788 (GET /state ok)
live_reproduction.flow: Sessions rail -> Open the active session -> type 'reply with exactly: PONG' -> Send

at_turn_resolution.note: reply appended at T+3.5s, then the conversation collapsed to the greeting at T+4.2s

after.note: thread stays in front from just-sent through T+7.0s; the reply (203rd node) is visible

reload_restores_session.note: refreshActive() loads the active session's turns; the surface is computed from them

asserts: a just-finished turn keeps the conversation on screen (turns>0, busy=false -> visible)
a live turn is shown before the first reply
the greeting shows only with no conversation and no live turn
a tool call / approval turn stays in the session through to its result
a reloaded session with history starts on the conversation
presence.ts computes the surface from conversationVisible
presence.ts no longer removes `.talking` on turn completion
